notes.title: 🚨 Major Overhaul Incoming – Last Whisper Survival is Getting Reborn!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve got big news.[/p][p][i]Last Whisper Survival[/i] is undergoing a complete rework — from the ground up. After taking in all your feedback (and lots of late-night brainstorming), we’re redesigning the game to make it [b]more fun, more immersive, and way more rewarding[/b].[/p][p]Here’s what’s coming:[/p][p]🌍 [b]Brand-New, Bigger Map[/b]
We’re expanding the world to bring more areas to explore, more danger zones, and more reasons to wander off the beaten path.[/p][p]🚗 [b]Car Storage System[/b]
Vehicles will finally have real purpose — load up your loot, store your gear, and explore without constantly worrying about inventory limits.[/p][p]🧟‍♂️ [b]New Boss System (Gear Score-Based)[/b]
We’re introducing raid-style bosses that scale with your gear score. The stronger your gear, the tougher the boss you can take on — and the better the rewards. It’s all about risk and reward.[/p][p]🎯 [b]Improved Rarity System for Weapons[/b]
Weapons will now have a deeper rarity and stat system, making loot hunts more exciting and meaningful.[/p][p]🧭 [b]More Quests, More Progression[/b]
We’re adding more quests to follow, so you’re never lost wondering what to do next. You’ll have goals, story beats, and rewards to chase.[/p][p]🔧 [b]Revamped Mechanics & Combat[/b]
Core gameplay is being fine-tuned to feel better in your hands — smoother combat, smarter systems, and a better survival loop overall.[/p][p]This isn’t just a patch. It’s a [b]reimagining[/b] of what [i]Last Whisper Survival[/i] can be.[/p][p]We’re doing all this to make the game something truly worth playing — and sticking with. You’ve supported us through the early days, and we’re determined to deliver something great in return.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing sneak peeks and devlogs along the way, so stay tuned. And as always, your feedback is gold — don’t hesitate to share your ideas with us.

We know it’s been a while since the last update — and we really appreciate your patience. The truth is, we didn’t just want to patch a few things and call it a day. We took a step back and realized the game had way more potential, so we made the decision to [b]rebuild core parts of the experience[/b] instead of rushing out small fixes. That takes time — from reworking the map and systems to adding new content like bosses, quests, and gear mechanics — but we believe it’s worth it. Our goal is to make something [b]more solid, more fun, and way more exciting[/b] for everyone.
[/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey.[/p]

notes.title: Roadmap - Last Whisper
notes.notes:
🚧 Gradual game overhaul with a new map, improved immersion, and deeper storytelling.

💬 Personal Message:
[i]"I lost motivation for a while, but I’ll try to keep going. Thank you to my friend Bruko for the support.

I also want to sincerely apologize to my community and thank you all for your support. Your patience and feedback mean a lot, and I will do my best to deliver the experience you deserve."[/i]


Phase 1: Stabilization and Improvements (1-2 months)

✅ Fix bugs reported by Steam players.
✅ Optimize co-op mode (latency, synchronization, enemy AI).
✅ Improve movement (fluidity, collision fixes, possible parkour?).
✅ Work on first-person mode for a better feel.
✅ Add more visual effects:

    Bullet impacts on zombies and environments.
    Better tree and rock destruction effects.
    Blood and damage on zombies (dismemberment, crawling after losing limbs).

Phase 2: Map Overhaul & Story Integration (3-4 months)

🌍 New map with a mix of post-apocalyptic and sci-fi elements:

    Replace the old Stalker-like atmosphere with a more diverse setting.
    Add abandoned secret labs where mutant experiments took place.
    Introduce high-tech bunkers and factories where tests went wrong.
    Create partially rebuilt cities, home to survivors and factions.
    Expand biomes and explorable areas (desert, contaminated forests, modern ruins).

📖 Integrating a narrative:

    Story of a biotech disaster that led to the apocalypse.
    Audio logs and notes revealing the truth behind lab experiments.
    Survivors with dialogues and side quests.
    Secret locations containing clues about the mutant origins.

Phase 3: New Content & Gameplay Features (4-5 months)

🚗 Vehicles Overhaul & Expansion:

    Improve driving physics for a smoother experience.
    More drivable vehicles (motorcycles, trucks, armored vehicles).
    Ability to upgrade and repair vehicles.

🧟 Enemy Evolution:

    New types of zombies, including lab-created mutants.
    Zombies can crawl after losing their legs.
    Mini-bosses in high-risk zones.

📦 Dynamic World Events:

    Airdrops containing rare military loot.
    Mutant attacks in key areas that need defending.
    Radioactive zones requiring special gear for exploration.

Phase 4: Community Involvement & Final Adjustments (6+ months)

📢 Engaging with players for further improvements:

    Gather player feedback to refine the game’s direction.
    Balance difficulty and mechanics based on community input.
    Add seasonal updates (special events, unique loot).

notes.title: Controls in Last Whisper Survival: A Guide for Players
notes.notes:
Welcome to Last Whisper Survival! 

As you embark on your journey through the treacherous world of survival, mastering the controls is essential for your survival. In this guide, we'll delve into the various controls and features that might have slipped under your radar, ensuring you make the most out of your gameplay experience.

**Basic Movement:**

W/A/S/D: Navigate your character through the environment.
Spacebar: Jump to overcome obstacles.
Shift: Sprint for a burst of speed, but be wary of stamina depletion.
Ctrl: Crouch to sneak past enemies or avoid detection.

**View and Camera Controls:**

[b]V: Toggle between different views, including first-person and third-person perspectives.[/b]

Hold V in third-person: Switch the camera angle to the opposite side, providing a different vantage point.
Mouse Scroll Wheel: Adjust the camera distance for a better view of your surroundings.

**Combat Maneuvers:**

Left Mouse Button: Primary attack with equipped weapon.
Right Mouse Button: Aim down sights for improved accuracy.
Double Ctrl: Execute a dodge roll to evade enemy strikes or reposition during combat.
R: Reload your weapon to ensure you're always ready for action.
E: Interact with objects, loot containers, and perform various actions within the game world.

**Inventory and Equipment:**

Tab: Open your inventory to manage items, equip gear, and view your current loadout.
Hold T: Display additional information about your equipped weapon, including attachments and modifications.

**Communication and Teamplay:**

Enter: Open the chat window to communicate with other players in the game.

Remember, mastering these controls will greatly enhance your gameplay experience in Last Whisper Survival. 

Whether you're navigating through hostile territories, engaging in intense firefights, or strategizing with your team, familiarity with the controls is key to survival. 

So, dive in, experiment, and embrace the challenges that await you in this immersive survival adventure!

One of the most significant additions to Last Whisper Survival is the introduction of a first-person shooter (FPS) view. notes.title: Devlog #02: Last Whisper Survival - The struggle
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/4c663dfe7bc114a73accbb1e0750fd8c2384dbf1.png[/img]



Greetings, survivors! We're thrilled to announce the latest update for Last Whisper Survival, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your survival experience. Let's dive into the details:


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172320/Last_Whisper_Survival][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/1be37164b72e09305426ef864273240b5ff2979e.png[/img][/url]



New Vehicles and Car Horns:
Get ready to explore the post-apocalyptic world in style with the addition of new 2-seater and 4-seater cars! These vehicles not only allow you to cover ground faster but also come equipped with horns, adding a new level of communication and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/9a46d21ed90d126d883c52c8896887516d74b979.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/ece4211bc641228bb764841ba028f89f6b3eef99.png[/img]

Revamped Quest System:
Now, some quests will require you to reach specific waypoints instead of collecting items, giving you more flexibility in how you approach challenges.

Expanded Item Variety:
We've added more items throughout the maps to enrich your scavenging experience. Discover new resources and tools to aid you in your quest for survival.

The Vast Desert Awaits:
Prepare for a new biome in the game – the scorching desert! Navigate the sands, face unique challenges, and seek rare resources that can only be found in this unforgiving environment.

Embrace the Coastal Life:
As you explore the world, you'll now encounter coastal areas with pristine beaches and water bodies. Watch out for potential dangers but also enjoy the serenity of these new locations.

Upgraded Weapon Arsenal:
Take your combat skills to the next level with new tiers (7) of shotgun and pistol weaponry. Gear up and make those zombies think twice before attacking you!

Zombie Effects and Behavior:
The undead have become more fearsome with this update. They now display gruesome effects such as blood splatters and losing body parts upon being hit. However, they can no longer lose their legs and right arms, making each encounter more strategic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/9325a6f773ed1ba277da989bac3362c8ea0e8762.png[/img]


Improved Camp Items:
Camps are now more diverse, with a wider array of items available for you to find and use. Build and fortify your bases with newfound resources.

Interactive Tree Hits:
Interact with the environment in a more immersive way with the new effect on hitting trees. Experience realistic reactions as you gather resources for your survival.

Enhanced Desert Roads:
Traverse the desert more efficiently with the addition of roads, making your journey through this vast landscape a bit smoother.

Flip Cars with Precision:
Utilize the 'Z' input to flip overturned cars back on their wheels. Master this skill to escape tricky situations and continue your journey without delay.

Dynamic Weather and Lighting:
Prepare for a more immersive experience as we've overhauled the weather system and lighting. Brace yourself for changing conditions that can influence your survival strategy.

New Routes to the City:
Discover new roads leading to the city, providing alternate paths to explore and loot.

Loot Overhaul:
To increase the challenge, we've balanced loot distribution. Expect more loot items inside houses and camps but a reduced number of loot opportunities in boxes and other containers.

Expanded Armor Options:
Equip yourself with the latest armor sets designed for both men and women, giving you more choices to create your unique survivalist look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/68dd5d7649c2f419379a8c0c9247e9d9e701c7d5.png[/img]

We hope you're as excited as we are about this update. The team has put in countless hours to bring you these new features and improvements. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please share your thoughts on our social media platforms or the official discord.

Follow us and share your screenshots on these platforms:

Our Discord Server: [url=https://discord.gg/QDeakxU484]Discord[/url]

Survive, scavenge, and thrive in the harsh world of Last Whisper Survival! Good luck out there, survivors!

Welcome to the first devlog for Last Whisper Survival, a thrilling post-apocalyptic game where you must navigate a mutant-infested world and fight for your survival. I'm thrilled to announce that Last Whisper Survival now features brand new 3D models for cities, breathing life into the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Explore the desolate streets, decaying buildings, and hidden treasures as you uncover the secrets of this grim world. Furthermore, I've implemented RPG mechanics that allow you to customize your character's stats and utilize a weapon system inspired by the beloved Borderlands series. Prepare for intense battles with mutants by upgrading your weapons and adapting your playstyle to survive.

One of my top priorities is ensuring that you can make your character truly unique. I'm currently working on expanding the customization options, allowing you to choose from a variety of outfits, accessories, and appearance modifications. Stand out in the wasteland and leave your mark on this unforgiving world.

Remember to Add Last Whisper Survival to Your Wishlist:

Your support as a solo developer means the world to me, and I'm excited to share my creation with you.

What's Coming Next:
In the upcoming weeks, I'll be focusing on refining gameplay mechanics, expanding the mutant-infested world, and polishing the overall experience. My goals include enhancing combat, implementing new quests and missions, and ensuring a smooth and immersive gaming experience that resonates with the survival genre fans.
